module.title: Pharmacy
module.description: Medicine shop: medicines by brand and generic, selling by piece, strip or box within MRP, expiry and the controlled-drug register.

sell.title: Sell medicines
sell.text: Find by brand or generic name, or scan. The batch that expires first (and is still good) is sold.
sell.no_counter_text: Set up a counter in POS (which branch, which warehouse, which payments). Then come back here.
sell.open_text: Count the cash in the drawer before the first sale.
sell.saved_offline: Saved on this device. It is sent when the internet is back.
sell.search: Brand or generic name, or scan the barcode
sell.no_medicines_text: Add medicines in the medicine list, then buy them in Purchases.
sell.not_found: Nothing found. Try the generic name.
sell.hint: Start typing a name. Press Enter after scanning.
sell.prescription_hint: Enter the patient's name and the doctor's BMDC no. to sell a controlled medicine.
sell.no_substitutes: No other brand of the same generic and strength is in the list.
sell.controlled_offline: Controlled medicines are not sold offline. Wait for the internet.
sell.offline_off: Selling offline is switched off for this counter.

medicines.title: Medicines
medicines.text: Every medicine with its generic, strength, form, MRP and packs.
medicines.none_found: No medicine matches. Try another name.
medicines.mrp_hint: The price printed on the pack, for one piece.
medicines.above_mrp: The selling price cannot be above the MRP.

purchases.title: Purchases
purchases.text: Medicines bought, with batch and expiry. Stock is there to sell at once.
purchases.empty_text: Record what you bought, with batch and expiry.

stock.title: Stock and expiry
stock.text: Every batch on the shelf with its expiry. Red: sell first or return.
stock.empty_all: No medicine in stock yet. Buy some in Purchases.
stock.empty_expired: No expired medicine on the shelf.

returns.text: Expired or expiring batches going back. Someone else approves; then stock goes down.
returns.empty_text: Start one from Stock and expiry, or with "New return".
returns.decide_text: Approved, the batches leave the stock.

controlled.title: Controlled-drug register
controlled.text: Every controlled medicine in and out, with batch, balance and for whom. Nothing here can be changed.
controlled.empty_text: Buying or selling a controlled medicine writes it here.

reports.title: Pharmacy reports
reports.text: Sales per day, and stock by expiry worth at MRP.
reports.empty_sales: No pharmacy sales in these dates.
reports.empty_expiry: No medicine is expiring or expired.

sell.title: How to sell

steps.1: Type the medicine: search by brand or generic name, or scan the barcode.
steps.2: Tap Piece, Strip or Box; change the quantity with + and −.
steps.3: The batch expiring first (and still good) is sold for you. Red means it expires soon.
steps.4: Out of stock? Tap "Substitutes" to see other brands of the same generic.
steps.5: Take the payment (cash, card, bKash/Nagad) and print the receipt.

tips.1: You cannot charge above the MRP, and expired batches are never sold.
tips.2: No internet? Keep selling; sales are sent when you are back online.

mistakes.1: A controlled medicine needs the patient's name and the doctor's BMDC number.

sell.settings: Near-expiry days, loose pieces and the prescription rule are in the Pharmacy settings.

steps.2: Enter the brand name, generic, strength (e.g. 500 mg) and form.
steps.3: Enter the MRP of one piece, the pieces in a strip and the strips in a box.
steps.4: Add the barcode and DGDA number if you have them, then Save.

tips.1: Leave the selling price empty to sell at the MRP; it can never be higher.

mistakes.1: Add the generic first (Settings → Generics); mark controlled ones there.

steps.1: Enter the supplier and the date.
steps.2: For each medicine: the pack, how many, the cost of one pack, the batch number and the expiry.
steps.3: Tap "Save the purchase": stock goes up at once.

mistakes.1: A batch without an expiry date is not accepted; copy it from the pack.

stock.title: How to watch expiry

steps.1: Pick at the top: all, expiring soon, to return, or expired.
steps.2: Sell red rows first, or return them to the supplier.
steps.3: Tap "Return" on a row to start a supplier return with it.

stock.settings: How many days count as "soon" is in the Pharmacy settings.

returns.title: How to return to a supplier

steps.1: Tap "New return" (or "Return" in Stock and expiry).
steps.2: Choose the supplier, the medicine and batch, and how many pieces; write why.
steps.3: Send for approval: someone else approves it, then the stock goes down.

tips.1: Customers' returns are made from the POS sale (Sales → the receipt).

steps.1: Choose the medicine and the dates.
steps.2: See every in and out with the batch, the balance, the patient and the doctor's BMDC number.

tips.1: Nothing here can be deleted or changed; each reading is recorded.

steps.1: Add each generic name once (e.g. Paracetamol).
steps.2: Tick "Controlled medicine" for controlled ones: their sales then need a prescription and go into the register.

steps.1: Add the companies that make your medicines.
